name: 6b6t
description:
6b6t is a Minecraft anarchy server with no rules, where over 150 players come daily to play, build, raid, and explore. You can hack, grief, dupe items, and set up bases without any restrictions. Popular commands like /tpa and /home allow you to quickly teleport to friends or set home points, making it easy to travel and connect with others.

The server runs on custom technology that supports up to 1,000 players at once, so there’s no lag or queue, even with large player counts. 6b6t also uses the same world seed as 2b2t (-4172144997902289642), so players can explore familiar landscapes while building, battling, or teaming up for massive projects.

6b6t is compatible with both Java and Bedrock versions of Minecraft. For Java, join with the IP join.6b6t.org; for Bedrock, use bedrock.6b6t.org and Port 19132. Whether you’re looking to start massive builds, raid enemy bases, or explore an open world with full freedom to do as you like, 6b6t lets you jump in and start playing right away.
